description: Maya has a furnished room opening in her apartment and must make the final call on whether to sublet it to Jordan, settling the rent, payment timing, move-in date, and household quiet hours with input from Jordan and the other roommate.

shared_context.S1: Maya's furnished spare room will be available for an informal two-month sublet.
shared_context.S2: Maya will make the final decision about whether to proceed and will settle the terms verbally.
shared_context.S3: Jordan has expressed interest in taking the room, and Elena lives in the apartment.
shared_context.S4: This conversation is the same-day household check-in before the decision: Maya asks Jordan to state his proposed rent, payment timing, and move-in date, then asks Elena to state any specific household term, and Maya finalizes the arrangement immediately after both have answered.

PF1.text: Jordan's actual offer is exactly $900 per month, with exactly two months paid upfront, and a move-in date of exactly August 1.

PF2.text: Elena works remotely early each morning and requires quiet hours exactly from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. throughout the sublet.

acceptance_conditions: Maya must accept Jordan's sublet proposal.
The monthly rent must be exactly $900.
Exactly two months of rent must be paid upfront.
The move-in date must be exactly August 1.
The agreement must specify quiet hours exactly from 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.
A quiet-hours commitment targeting the apartment must be logged.
Jordan's proposed terms must be cited as justification after Jordan states them aloud.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'quiet_hours' and c['target'] == 'apartment' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's private offer changes the settlement to acceptance at exactly $900 per month, exactly two months paid upfront, and exactly an August 1 move-in date.
Elena's work schedule changes the household term to exact quiet hours of 22:00-07:00 and requires a matching apartment-wide commitment.
